cards.scope: NL Gendergap maintenance project focus list
cards.claim: The NL Gendergap maintenance project, which aims to bridge the gender gap on the Dutch-language Wikipedia, has Marijke Lagerlöf on its focus list.
cards.quote: This is where the NL Gendergap maintenance project comes into play. Launched by a group of dedicated Wikipedians, this initiative aims to bridge the gender gap on the Dutch-language Wikipedia by creating and improving articles about notable women. The project's focus list, a curated selection of individuals who have made significant contributions to their respective fields, features none other than Marijke Lagerlöf.

raw_card.claim: Marijke Lagerlöf has been included on the focus list of the Wikimedia project WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list.
